# Security Review Activity Recount

Recount of activity across four rooms: `general-meshworks-security`,
`security-095`, `security-v1-041`, `security-v3-065`.

## Method

For each room the full channel history was read (all four returned
`has_more: false`, so every top-level message was captured). A top-level
message is one with no `thread_ts` or with `thread_ts == ts`; messages
that carry `thread_ts != ts` are thread replies (some are also broadcast
into the channel and so re-appear in history, but are counted once, as
replies).

Every thread parent (`thread_ts == ts`, `reply_count >= 1`) was opened
and read in full. The reply count retrieved from each thread matched the
`reply_count` summary on the parent in every case, so nothing was missed.
Replies were taken from the thread reads (not the channel list) to avoid
double counting broadcast replies.

Nothing was excluded by how it was posted: messages flagged `hidden` and
`bot_message` / `file_share` subtypes are all counted.

### Metric definitions
- **messages** = top-level messages + all thread replies.
- **replies** = messages that live inside a thread (`thread_ts != ts`).
- **threads_with_replies** = top-level messages that started a thread and
  received at least one reply.
- **people_who_replied** = distinct accounts that authored at least one
  reply (union across the four rooms for the TOTAL).
- **replies_from_outside_the_openers** = replies whose author never
  started a thread of their own in any of the four rooms. The "openers"
  set is the union of all thread-parent authors across all four rooms.

## Per-room results

| room | messages | replies | threads_with_replies | people_who_replied | replies_from_outside_the_openers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| general-meshworks-security | 11 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| security-095 | 11 | 4 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| security-v1-041 | 15 | 7 | 6 | 4 | 1 |
| security-v3-065 | 19 | 11 | 7 | 6 | 2 |
| **TOTAL** | **56** | **25** | **17** | **15** | **8** |

## Per-room evidence

### general-meshworks-security (CV22RIS8EUFS)
Top-level (non-reply): 8. Threads (2), each opened:
- `1771275919.597351` (opener UYWISLX0GUBU) — 2 replies: UGLE5KBIBJI9, UROL2F11ZKXJ
- `1771228895.364693` (opener UROL2F11ZKXJ) — 1 reply: UGLE5KBIBJI9

Replies = 3. messages = 8 + 3 = 11. Repliers: UGLE5KBIBJI9, UROL2F11ZKXJ (2).
Outside replies: UGLE5KBIBJI9 x2 (UGLE5KBIBJI9 is not an opener anywhere) = 2.
(UROL2F11ZKXJ is an opener in this room, so its reply is not "outside".)

### security-095 (CRTSMZXIYU27, private)

- `1771248864.040782` (opener U4TC63N47PUS) — 2 replies: UPLCK9I5ENM9, U4TC63N47PUS

Outside replies: UM871GLG615Z (1) + UPLCK9I5ENM9 x2 = 3. (U4TC63N47PUS is an opener here.)

### security-v1-041 (C893RPE2V5HO)
Top-level (non-reply): 8. Threads (6):

UPD2Q8E3RYIK, UEJV5FXOKTKW.

Accounts that replied but never opened a thread in these four rooms (6):
UGLE5KBIBJI9, UM871GLG615Z, UPLCK9I5ENM9, UCOCV576CWC1, UV4OASVMMBZF,

as UGLE5KBIBJI9 x2, UM871GLG615Z x1, UPLCK9I5ENM9 x2, UCOCV576CWC1 x1,
UV4OASVMMBZF x1, UNN2VSEY3JSW x1).

## Conclusion

Totals across the four rooms: 56 messages said in all, of which 25 were
thread replies; 17 threads were started and all 17 got at least one
reply; 15 distinct accounts replied; 8 of those replies came from

four rooms. Reply counts were verified thread-by-thread against the
`reply_count` summary on each parent and matched exactly.
